question: Which divine figures are invoked as weapon-bearing after the utterance 'akṣama'?
premises: Then the gods beginning with Indra are invoked.
These gods are endowed with weapons.
inference: After saying 'akṣama', one invokes the gods led by Indra, all bearing weapons.
uncertainties: The precise ritual role of the utterance 'akṣameti' is not fully explained in this verse.
plain_english: Saying 'akṣama', then the gods beginning with Indra, endowed with weapons, are invoked.
